andreea.name: Andreea Popescu
andreea.title: Confidence restored
andreea.text: Premium Smile transformed my confidence. The team explained every step, and the result is the smile I dreamed of.

mihai.name: Mihai Ionescu
mihai.title: Calm, professional, kind
mihai.text: From consultation to follow-up, the experience felt like a spa, not a clinic. I cannot recommend them enough.

elena.name: Elena Dumitru
elena.title: Worth every minute
elena.text: I drove two hours each way and would do it again. Painless, gorgeous results, and the kindest staff.

radu.name: Radu Marin
radu.title: First clinic without fear
radu.text: I have always been anxious at the dentist. Here, for the first time, I felt completely safe. They listened.

ioana.name: Ioana Stan
ioana.title: Like a different person
ioana.text: Eighteen months of clear aligners, weekly check-ins, zero pressure. My alignment and bite are finally right.

cristian.name: Cristian Voicu
cristian.title: They saw the whole picture
cristian.text: Other clinics gave me a price. Premium Smile gave me a plan. Three years later, my mouth is healthy.

ana.name: Ana Petrescu
ana.title: My kids actually ask to go
ana.text: Two children, zero tantrums. The pediatric room and the staff make every visit feel like an adventure.

intro.title: Meet the Premium Smile team
intro.dedication: Our doctors are deeply committed to every patient who walks through our doors. They lead with patience, attention, and a steady hand — choosing every plan with the person in front of them in mind, not a checklist. The result is care that feels personal because it is.

elena.name: Dr. Elena Marin
elena.bio: Dr. Marin leads the clinic with a commitment to patient-first care. Every plan she designs starts from listening, not from a procedure list — and the work is shaped by the person in front of her.

andrei.name: Dr. Andrei Popescu
andrei.bio: Dr. Popescu builds long-term relationships with his patients. He explains every step before it happens, so consent is informed and trust grows over years, not appointments.

mihai.name: Dr. Mihai Stoica
mihai.bio: Dr. Stoica is known for his calm, methodical approach. Patients who arrived nervous tend to leave relaxed — and come back.
